description: No-op operations must fail loudly. A roadmap operation that matches nothing currently reports success, so a caller cannot distinguish 'applied' from 'affected nothing' — this is why SmartMemory's migration ticket sat mis-scoped from 2026-06-19 until 2026-09-11. Three instances found in one afternoon: (a) `roadmap_graph_check` returned matches:false plus 'stale … run compose roadmap graph' when the truth was that canon is 3% populated (19 feature.json across 642 folders, 0 deps.yaml) and regenerating would replace a 2,779-line 370-node hand-maintained graph with a 4-node 0-edge one — staleness and not-populated are different facts and it cannot tell them apart. (b) server/feature-scan.js:186-192 asserts the vision store 'is a managed projection of feature.json, not a thing that drifts from it (COMP-ROADMAP-GRAPH-2)', yet .compose/data/vision-state.json holds 644 features and 130 status conflicts with ROADMAP.md across 515 overlapping features, with records self-contradicting internally (BENCH-APP-BREADTH-1: status:complete, phase:verification, lifecycle.currentPhase:explore_design) — nothing detected it. (c) `migrateRoadmap` wrote 0 files and exited 0 (see COMP-ROADMAP-PROSE-READ). Precedent to follow: protectResidue() (lib/roadmap-residue.js:261) turns silent loss into a one-command fix. Source of record: /Users/ruze/reg/my/SmartMemory/smart-memory-docs/docs/features/ROADMAP-MIGRATE-1/design.md.

links.note: All three silent no-op instances were found during that investigation.
